stories.title: KnowBe4 and AWS: Behind Every AI Advancement Is Strong Collaboration
stories.summary: Delivering AI-native security awareness training through the KnowBe4 Platform to more than 70,000 users means collaboration.

stories.title: Hackers compromise 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials
stories.summary: A new campaign dubbed 'wfx-loot' has unfolded on GitHub where threat actors used 4,837 compromised accounts to probe 61,764 repositories, open pull requests, and push secrets-stealing malware.

stories.title: Massive Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook, Teams, Copilot worldwide
stories.summary: Microsoft is investigating a widespread outage affecting multiple Microsoft 365 services, including Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, as users report connectivity problems worldwide.

stories.title: Tech Companies Are Trying to Shift the Concept of Privacy (Again)
Italy fines Meta $880mn over photo privacy
stories.summary: Italy's data protection authority accused Facebook's parent company of accessing users' photos 'without obtaining specific consent and without properly informing them.'

stories.title: Expect more flight cancelations, US transport chief says
stories.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said it remains 'safe to fly' after an hours-long ground stop, but warned of more flight cancelations as airlines grapple with thousands of stranded passengers

stories.title: Who are the 'street medics' showing up at protests around the world?
stories.summary: From treating tear gas exposure to tending to injuries, street medics have become an increasingly common sight at protests all over the world. But who exactly are they and when did they start showing up at demonstrations? Story by Daniel Quinlan.

stories.title: Diva? “Maybe I need a little more of that in myself”: Pegula and Andreeva, the WTA Finals ‘divas’, meet for the first time in the semi-finals
stories.summary: A week after being caught on a hot mic calling Mirra Andreeva “a diva”, Jessica Pegula faces the Russian for the first time in the first semi-final of the WTA Finals in Indian Wells on Saturday.

stories.title: Sabalenka's season ended by Svitolina at WTA Finals
stories.summary: Aryna Sabalenka's season ends in disappointment as Elina Svitolina beats the former world number one to claim her place in the knockout stage at the WTA Finals.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.
